subject: MSstats team is looking for TAs in ASMS Fall workshop (contact info changed!)

messages.author: 3527bc98ac33a674
messages.subject: MSstats team is looking for TAs in ASMS Fall workshop (contact info changed!)
parts:
Dear MSstats community,

(If you already sent to me, please replay this email again. Sorry for the trouble.)

MSstats team organizes ASMS Fall workshop(link) for R fundamental and best practice for MS data analysis on the coming November 7(Sat)-8(Sun), 14(Sat)-15(Sun) ( 3 hrs/day, from 12 pm to 3 pm ). We are looking for TAs from MSstats community to help participants and answer the questions more closely during workshops. More details are : 
- It will be similar to May Institute : Beginner R module + Stat MS (MSstats) module. But, this is the first trial of the online training course. Most of the participants are very beginner at R.
- We will have 3 hrs, including lecture + hands-on, per day. We will use a zoom webinar for lectures. There are some hands-on sections between lectures. For hands-on, each TA will have their own zoom room and will answer the questions with up to 5 participants.
- There is a TA training session on Oct 22, 12 pm EST, which will give TAs more details about contents and practice some tech.
- TA will receive an honorarium from ASMS. The honorarium might be different by the number of days to teach.
- We hope that TAs can join for all 4 days. However, if you can make more than 2 days, it should be fine.
- Extra : it will be a great chance to talk with the MSstats team and among MSstats community :)

If you want to join as TAs, please replay this email by Oct 17th (Sat) with the details below,
- name
- affiliation
- email
- level of experience in R
- experience in MSstats : how long or how often you use MSstats
- dates that you can join : for example, 7,8, 14
- whether you can join TA training session

If you have any question, please email me. Hope to be a good chance to work with MSstats community!

- Meena
